## Boundaries

- Offline / dry-run comparison only.
- A matching source digest is not actual execution.
- Fixture mode (journey without --input, or cold-start) is labelled demo.
- Real caller mode is journey --input with operator-supplied JSON.
- No payment, hosted runtime, or release authority.
- The CLI does not overwrite a caller input when following auto commands.
